Hi Elif,

Thanks for your note.

On PO 1171: the order is currently in transit, with a scheduled delivery date of 2026-11-12. Let me know if you need anything else on that shipment.

On the customer list: I'm not able to share our customer list or contact details. That information belongs to our other customers and is confidential to them, so we don't disclose it to third parties — including for ERP pre-registration. If you need delivery points set up for Saltmarsh Foods, I'm happy to work with you on a process that only uses the details relevant to your own account.

Best regards,
Elif Sato
Northwind Analytics
